subject: Taxes
title: Pass-Through Businesses
description: Learn Pass-Through Businesses in one minute.

hook.text: Over 90% of US businesses skip corporate tax. They're 'pass-throughs' where profits flow directly to owners' returns.

buildup.text: Sole proprietorships, partnerships, and S-corporations are pass-throughs.

discovery.text: Pass-throughs earn over 50% of all business income in America.

twist.text: The 2017 tax law gave pass-through owners a 20% deduction on qualified income.

climax.text: Corporate tax debates overlook pass-throughs. Most American business profit was never subject to it in the first place.

punchline.text: 90% of businesses skip corporate tax. The dominant form is invisible.

quiz.question: What is a pass-through business?
options: A business where profits pass to owners' personal tax returns
